scope: Owned document transform preparation and exact precommit validation
changes: Runtime-free request-effect coalescing and graph projection helpers shared by ordinary execution and owned preparation.
Owned request operands and order-sensitive fingerprints independent of caller buffers.
Bounded transform base copies retain no read transaction; parsing, resolution, hashing, mapping and text preparation occur after capture admission releases.
Current revision/timestamp/content witnesses reject changed primary bytes with equal timestamps; unchanged primary content survives artifact-only revision changes.
Final commit borrows owned postimages and validates their source witnesses before primary mutation.
Known precommit stale inputs release admission and reprepare within the request busy budget; committed results never enter that retry path.
Owned increments and cheap text publication share one native checkpoint and, in the durable fixture, one sync.
